name: Columbia State Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Out-of-state 2026-27 from columbiastate.edu tuition-and-fees page: $342/hr tuition (12 hrs = $4,104) + $193 mandatory access fees per semester = $4,297/semester x 2 = $8,594/yr. In-state basis matches known $5,114 ($197/hr x 12 + $193 fees = $2,557 x 2).
